lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd4Pb2Ge4 (Nd2PbGe2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 10-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with 9 neighbors (2 Ge, 3 Nd, 4 Pb), Nd centers with 12 neighbors (4 Ge, 4 Nd, 4 Pb), and Pb centers with 7 Ge neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Ge 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ge and Nd 12-vertex polyhedra.
